rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai builds production-ready AI agent infrastructure for regulated industries, while Ooi Yee Fei is actively architecting AI agent ecosystems and specializes in the exact infrastructure patterns (MCP protocols, multi-agent architectures, token management) that underpin that kind of system. Both are deeply focused on making AI agents practical and production-ready rather than experimental — Sharon from the infrastructure vendor side, Ooi from the builder and architect side — making them natural collaborators on the technical and strategic challenges of scaling agent systems.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Ooi Yee Fei — they're building AI agent ecosystems with deep expertise in production protocols and architecture patterns that directly align with TheAgentic.Ai's infrastructure work, and they're explicitly open to collaboration and fractional CTO opportunities.
